pipeline_reference: supplement to S2.4 (BERT-TextCNN) and EXP-S2A (sentence-level modality classification); not a replacement for the EStG-150 S2.10 formal comparison

task.goal: Compare a traditional keyword classifier, a BiLSTM classifier, a CNN classifier, the project's Sun BERT-TextCNN reconstruction and LLM-SE on the same German sentences, split, four labels and evaluator.
task.target: sentence-level modality label among definition / obligation / permission / prohibition
explicitly_not: an EStG-150 Part 2 rerun or replacement
a claim of Sun author-original code or original split
a vehicle for inserting Sun paper-reported scores into our result tables

dataset.redistribution: raw sentences, vectors and row-level predictions stay local; only aggregate metrics and hashes are versioned
dataset.historical_test_use: the same 426-row test split was already used by the S2.4 candidate evaluation (2026-07-22) and the S2.7 modality alignment check (2026-08-08); it is therefore not a pristine held-out set for the Sun arm, and this limitation is reported

protocol.test_policy: one evaluation per arm after the configuration/checkpoint is frozen
forbidden: changing rules, hyperparameters, prompts or examples after seeing test labels
dropping failed samples or imputing labels for them
replacing measured values with paper-reported values
protocol.failure_policy: model/API/parse failure yields no prediction, stays in the denominator, lowers accuracy and gold-class recall, and is reported as failure_rate

cfkw.priority_and_fallback: selected on dev from four pre-declared (priority order, fallback) candidates
cfkw.negation_scope_rule: permission modal (darf/duerfen/kann/koennen/mag) followed within 4 tokens by nicht/kein/keine/keinen/keinesfalls/niemals -> prohibition

cfrnn.type: BiLSTM sentence classifier with corpus-trained embeddings
missing_details_in_paper: author LSTM hidden size, pooling and dropout
author optimizer, learning rate and epoch budget

cfcnn.type: Kim-style CNN sentence classifier with corpus-trained embeddings
missing_details_in_paper: author optimizer, learning rate and epoch budget

sun.trained_on: train 1985 rows, dev-selected best epoch (epoch 5 of 7)
sun.implementation_difference: candidate B uses inverse-sqrt class-frequency weighted cross-entropy; the S2.4 base config declares unweighted cross-entropy. The checkpoint is the one the project binds for the Sun baseline.
sun.retraining: none; inference only, and the reproduced macro-F1 must match the recorded value

llm_se.type: LLM-based Semantic Extraction; sentence modality taken from the produced record
llm_se.label_source: first clause with a non-empty modality label (same rule as the project evaluator)
llm_se.deviation: the frozen prompt was written for the English EStG-150 text; here it receives the German Sun sentence because all arms must see the same German original. This crosses the prompt's input language and is reported as a limitation.

budget_rules.hard_cap: spent + in-flight reservation must stay below the CNY cap before every send

llm_se.no_extra_prompt: no modality-only prompt is used in this run; if one were added it would have to be reported separately as 'LLM modality-only', never as the paper's LLM-SE

evaluation.paired_predictions: all arms predict the identical 426 sample_ids in the identical order
